name: Suzaku no Rei
source:
Earth Age: 20 years old.
Special Trait: His red tiara and shiny red feather
Element: Water
Abilities: Can control minds/Owns the Suzaku Feather Arrow/Attack Type

Tender and considerate, he's the type that worries about everything around him.
But he also has a heartless side where he will never give up on chasing something he considers an enemy.
Sometimes he acts like an innocent child.
